quotes.text: The titles seem to be a description and just run off. It's not informative at all.

fields.summary: Autonomous plan of a bug request: the web roadmap row title is the change set's whole intent (internal/web/roadmap.go sets Row.Title to c.Intent; the roadmap operation's change sets carry no title). Planned one leaf under web-roadmap-page serving m37-roadmap (decision web-redesign-direction: clear roadmap bugs ship at once as bug requests): the roadmap operation adds each change set's display title, and the web roadmap row shows it with the intent as a secondary line clamped to two lines. The runs list already shows the change set's display title and the change set page's depends-on list already uses change.show's title, so they need no change; the overview lists milestones, not change sets. No question was raised.
fields.title: Plan: web roadmap rows show change set titles
